tasks.title: Look around the 3D viewport
tasks.summary: Orbit, pan, zoom and get unlost.

steps.text: Orbit (rotate your view): hold the middle mouse button and drag. No middle button? Drag the small axis gizmo at the top-right of the viewport.
Pan (slide your view sideways): hold Shift and drag with the middle mouse button.
Zoom in and out by scrolling the mouse wheel.
Select an object, then zoom to it. On a laptop without a numpad, use View > Frame Selected in the viewport menu.
Lost in the scene? Show everything at once.

tasks.title: Add and delete objects
tasks.summary: Put shapes into the scene and remove them.

steps.text: Move your mouse over the viewport and open the Add menu.
Choose Mesh, then Cube. Or use the button below to do it for you.
Click an object in the viewport to select it. A selected object has an orange outline.
Remove the selected object. (X also works, but asks you to confirm.)

tasks.title: Move, rotate and scale
tasks.summary: The three basic ways to transform an object.

steps.text: Click an object to select it. If the scene is empty, add a cube first.
Press G to grab (move) the object. Move the mouse, then left-click to confirm, or press Esc to cancel.
To move along one direction only, press G, then X, Y or Z. Type a number such as 2 and press Enter for an exact distance.
Press R to rotate. Move the mouse and click to confirm. Type a number to rotate by exact degrees.
Press S to scale. Move the mouse and click to confirm. Type a number such as 2 to double the size.
Made a mistake? Undo it.

tasks.title: Edit an object's shape
tasks.summary: Enter Edit Mode and change vertices, edges and faces.

steps.text: Select a mesh object such as a cube. Add one if the scene is empty.
Switch to Edit Mode. You will see dots (vertices), lines (edges) and faces that you can change.
Choose what to select: 1 for vertices, 2 for edges, 3 for faces. The icons at the top of the viewport do the same.
Press 3, click one face of the cube, then press G and move the mouse. Click to confirm.
Return to Object Mode when you are done.

tasks.title: Extrude a face
tasks.summary: Pull a face outward to build new shape.

steps.text: Select a cube and enter Edit Mode.
Press 3 for face selection, then click one face of the cube.
Press E to extrude. Move the mouse to pull the face outward, then left-click to confirm.
Leave Edit Mode to see the result.

tasks.title: Add colour to an object
tasks.summary: Create a material and see it in the viewport.

steps.text: Click the object you want to colour.
In the Properties editor on the right, open the Material tab (a round sphere icon near the bottom of the tab column).
Click New, then click the Base Color box and pick a colour.
To see the colour in the viewport, switch to Material Preview (the third sphere icon at the top-right of the viewport).

tasks.title: Build a simple wall
tasks.summary: A civil starter: scale a cube into a wall.

steps.text: If the default cube is in the scene, select it and delete it.
Add a new cube.
With the cube selected, press S, then X, type 4 and press Enter. This stretches it into a wall about 8 metres long.
Press S, then Y, type 0.2 and press Enter to make the wall thin.
Press S, then Z, type 1.5 and press Enter to make the wall taller.
The wall now sinks below the ground grid. Press G, then Z, type 1.5 and press Enter to lift it so it sits on the ground.
